title: Pending fragment
description: One captured entry waiting to land: the lane it claims, the position it wants, the instant the capture stated, and the entry itself. A fragment states a delta, never a copy of anything a lane file holds. The entry mirrors the lane entry's field definitions so the fragment can be checked single-file; the lane file page owns the definitions, and keeping this mirror in agreement with the lane schema is a review responsibility. Closing fields are forbidden because a capture is never a close.

lane.description: The planning lane the entry wants to land in. A work lane is excluded: landing there would be a transition, and a transition owes a journal event.

after.description: Land beneath the named entry, or at the bottom of the claimed lane when null. The target must be a landed entry; a fragment-only target is drift the drain reports.

captured.description: The instant the capture stated, RFC 3339 UTC with Z, second precision. The drain's ordering key; nothing reads a filesystem timestamp or repository history.

entry.description: The entry as it will appear in the lane file, minus everything only a close may add.

id.description: The title's slug plus four lowercase hexadecimal characters.
